description: This file defines the "pImage" class, which is a core component of the pChart library used for generating images and charts. It includes methods for rendering images, managing image maps, setting graphical properties, and handling dataset attachments.

classes.name: pImage
classes.description: A class representing an image object capable of rendering charts and graphics, with properties for size, colors, font, shadows, and dataset attachment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the image object with specified dimensions and dataset.

methods.name: setShadow
methods.description: Enables or disables shadows with specified properties.

methods.name: setGraphArea
methods.description: Sets the coordinates for the graph drawing area within the image.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Outputs the image as a PNG file to the specified filename.

methods.name: stroke
methods.description: Outputs the image directly to the browser as PNG, with optional cache control.
